green-floral.title: Green Floral Kindle Insert, Vintage Botanical Design, Printable Clear Case Decor
green-floral.description:
Give your reading days a green floral refresh. This printable Kindle insert features the Green Floral artwork shown in the listing photos, ready to print and trim for your clear case.

DIGITAL DOWNLOAD ONLY
No physical insert, Kindle, case or other accessory is included.

YOU WILL RECEIVE
One ZIP containing Original-art.png, Custom-size.html, Read-me.txt and Quality-report.json. The offline HTML selector offers six Kindle and Kobo presets plus custom measured dimensions in cm. No PDF files are included.

PLEASE CHECK YOUR FIT
Measure the flat usable area inside your clear case before printing. Presets are device outlines, not physically tested case templates. Open the extracted HTML file in a desktop browser to adjust width, height and corners. Other models require your measurements. Artwork crops to fill different proportions.

HOW TO USE
Download and extract the ZIP. Print a plain-paper or outline test at 100% / Actual size, with Fit to page turned off. Check the 50 mm calibration line. Print the artwork, carefully trim and place it inside your compatible clear case.

GOOD TO KNOW
This is flattened artwork, not an editable Canva design. Printer, paper and screen colors vary. Larger sizes may show less detail. Personal use only; do not resell or redistribute the files. Kindle and Kobo names identify devices; BookishDaisy is independent of Amazon and Rakuten Kobo.

NEED HELP?
Message BookishDaisy on Etsy with your reader model and measured case dimensions.
